added.summary: The resource bar at the top left: each stockpile's picture in a cut tile, its amount large with a ceiling after it (the population's), and its income under it, green while it grows and red while it drains, or the game's word (Near cap) in gold at a limit; the age or tier on a lit tag. On a phone it takes the width on one or two compact rows.
The match clock at the top right: what it counts (Day 3), the time large and the game's speed on a tag, or Paused.
Alerts and notices as feed rows lit from their start edge, newest first: a mark and an edge in danger, done or info, the game's words and the key that jumps to it; an older notice set back.

Control groups and quick picks (the idle villagers, the army) as small plates with their key caps and counts, the group selected now lit and one that wants the player in gold. Reports pick with the group's key.

The RTS minimap: the whole map square in a lit-edged tile, your units, your allies' and your foes' as dots in their colours (a base larger, a resource a gold diamond), the camera's view as a white frame and each alert a red ring. Smaller on a phone.

The command card: abilities, orders and buildings as square tiles four to a row with their pictures, hotkeys in the corner, a cooldown as a dark sweep with its seconds, a command that cannot be paid for greyed with its price on a red tag, empty cells, the order in hand lit, and the info card of the command in focus over the grid (name, key, what it does, price, cooldown, when it is ready or why it cannot be used). Reports command with the tile's key; a disabled or unaffordable tile sends nothing. On a phone the grid takes the width, eight to a row, without the info card.

breaking.change: StrategySelection is the RTS selection panel drawn bare over the scene: the portrait in a lit tile with its health as a bar and in figures, the name large with how many are selected, its class line, a status tag and stats on tags (new props name, count, kind, line, status, portrait, icon, health, healthMax, stats keyed { id, label, value }), and every unit selected as a card with a health bar green, gold or red (data-tone), the focused card lit. The command card moved to StrategyCommands: the commands prop and the command intent are gone. Props title and summary are gone; a unit row's line and status fields are no longer read. Cards show only for two or more units. Its parts are StrategySelection.frame, .portrait, .health, .fill, .vital, .name, .count, .line, .status, .stat, .roster, .cell, .art, .meter and .badge; .band, .title, .detail, .grid, .command, .key, .reason, .picture, .well, .plate, .label, .headline, .caption, .figure, .track and .sweep are gone.
breaking.fix: Pass the focused unit's or subgroup's name, count, line, status, portrait or icon, health, healthMax and stats to StrategySelection, and its commands to StrategyCommands (rows { id, name, icon, glyph, key, action, enabled, affordable, cost, costIcon, cooldown, time, active, detail, cooldownText, readyText, reason }; label becomes name, hotkey becomes key, cooldownText the tile's figure becomes time). Drop title and summary. A style that dressed .detail or .headline dresses .name; .caption dresses .line or .status; .well, .track and .fill on a card dress .meter.

breaking.change: StrategyQueue is one bare row, as the selection panel's barracks queue: what produces in small capitals, the order in production as a larger tile with a dark sweep for what is still to run and its time, the orders waiting as smaller tiles, the free places up to the limit as empty tiles, the count over the limit on a tag (Queue full 5 / 5 when full), and Paused, or Blocked with the reason, as words after it. Tapping a tile reports cancel; there is no separate cancel button and no progress bar. New item field picture (a texture; 0 draws icon). The waiting word and the per-order name line are gone (the name is the tile's accessible name). The capacity reads 3 / 5. Its parts are StrategyQueue.frame, .title, .slot, .art, .sweep, .time, .badge, .open, .count, .state and .reason; .band, .row, .cell, .name, .headline and .caption are gone.
breaking.fix: Pass picture on each item (0 keeps the icon). A style that dressed .row or .cell dresses .slot; .band and .headline dress .title; .caption dresses .reason or .state. A page that set the queue on its own plate keeps the plate: the frame is bare.

breaking.change: StrategyWave is the wave plate at the top right: smoked glass with its edge lit in danger while a wave comes or fights, its picture (new prop icon), Wave n (of N) and its name (new prop name) in red capitals, the countdown as figures with a bar of the wait still to run, or Under attack or All waves cleared, the Final wave tag; the enemies under it as feed rows; Call early on a lit plate with its reward in gold. It no longer uses HudTimer: the countdown is a role=timer group, near its end it turns red (data-near). The Get ready word is gone from the countdown. Its parts are StrategyWave.frame, .plate, .icon, .label, .time, .bar, .fill, .state, .badge, .row, .mark, .name, .count, .call and .reward; .readout, .title, .figure and .caption are gone.
breaking.fix: Pass name and icon (both optional). A style that dressed .readout or .figure dresses .label, .time or .count; .title and .caption dress .label or .reward; HudTimer's parts inside the wave dress .time and .bar.

breaking.change: StrategyTower is dressed as the strategy HUD's plates: smoked glass with a lit top edge and two corners cut, the portrait in a lit tile, the name large, its stats on a dark well, each path a feed row edged by its state (accent, red, gold), its tier on a leaning bar, the buy plates and Sell on glass (an affordable buy lit). Names stay on one line and scroll when they overflow (a path's name no longer wraps). Its props and parts are unchanged.
breaking.fix: None needed; a style that dressed the tower's surfaces through the frame, band, card and badge tokens dresses its parts directly.
